sourceDecision: Retain production. The complete public QueryState function has no updatedAt reference, age calculation, timestamp formatting, or age/timestamp display branch. It renders Loading label when loading, Refreshing label when not loading and refreshing, stale text when usable data and stale, and an error alert with an optional retained-metadata suffix and Retry label. The incoming age/timestamp presentation premise is absent from this complete declaration; no timestamp feature or freshness change is authorized by that premise. Adjacent fresh() reads Date.now() and updatedAt but is a separate helper, incidentally visible and unevaluated here. Saved metadata-refresh/freshness sources select QueryState and use synthetic snapshots/clock machinery; the targeted freshness assertions check original updatedAt 1000 and stale status text, not an age/timestamp display. Targeted announcements/success sources supply synthetic updatedAt values. These are saved-source matches, not test execution, clock/timer correctness, mounted timing, announcements or actual AT qualification. No concrete supported correction compatible with frozen expectations was established.
